description: IVS - Índice de Vulnerabilidade Social à Ocorrência de Desastres Naturais (IVS) - Caieiras, Franco da Rocha, Francisco Morato - Fev/2021 is a dataset listed in Brazilian national spatial data infrastructure metadata catalogue (INDE), a metadata catalogue (CSW), published or maintained by Infraestrutura Nacional de Dados Espaciais (INDE). O Índice de Vulnerabilidade Social à Ocorrência de Desastres Naturais (IVS) foi criado para o trecho ferroviário entre as estações Caieiras e Francisco Morato, em SP, da Companhia Paulista de Trens Metropolitanos (CPTM). Coverage: Brasil. Its tags are Caieiras, Francisco, Morato, Franco, Rocha. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support natural hazard exposure and risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-csw-inde-portal.
